description: Triage incoming support tickets (工单/客诉/客户问题) by categorizing issues (分类问题), assigning priority P1-P4 (优先级/紧急程度), and recommending routing (路由/分配给团队). Use when a new ticket or customer issue comes in (处理新工单/客户反馈/投诉), when assessing severity (评估严重性/影响范围), or when deciding which team should handle an issue (确定处理团队/升级/分派). Keywords: 工单分类、客户支持、问题分级、SLA、故障定级、技术支持、Bug分级、客户投诉处理。
